title: Parameter-Decoupled Quantum Superresolution without Multiparameter Estimation
summary: Quantum superresolution promises to resolve closely spaced sources beyond the diffraction limit, but existing approaches generally rely on idealized source properties or require simultaneous estimation of multiple coupled parameters of realistic sources. Here we introduce a parameter-decoupled measurement that determines the separation of realistic passive sources without estimating their unknown brightness imbalance, mutual coherence, or relative phase.
